_about: How a World Athletics representative (manager) maps to an agency. 'by_website' uses the website World Athletics lists for the representative: an official link, with the agency name taken from that website. 'by_representative' is researched, for representatives listed without a website; each needs a reliability grade and a source.

Eric Lilot.note: A search summary says his World Athletics listing uses a Demadonna contact address; not checked on the page.
